items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I met a lot of guys there. Tubby Hayes and all those guys.

ctx.x: When was the first time, do remember the first time that you played in London so that these British musicians could have actually seen you perform?

Well the first I played in London I played at this place that Ronnie Scott used to have. What’s the name of that street? The place they had before that? Anyway I’d go there, if we had a day off we’d go down there cause they stayed open all night. I met a lot of guys there. Tubby Hayes and all those guys.
